children: Turkey's Financial Stability Committee said on Thursday that recent volatility in the markets posed no fundamental or structural risk to the functioning of Borsa Istanbul or the country's capital markets.

The committee said recent market volatility was driven by credit and liquidity problems at funds managed by a limited number of companies, adding that all measures would be implemented to ensure financial stability.
"Agreed measures will primarily focus on easing liquidity constraints and preventing contagion risk," the committee said in a statement after a meeting.
